text: また　きやがったな！

structure.en: you damn well showed up, huh!

patterns.name: 〜やがる
patterns.explanation: やがる stuck onto a shortened verb is very rough and shows anger or scorn at the person doing it. きやがった = 'you had the nerve to come'.

patterns.name: 〜な (exclamation)
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker's own feeling, here annoyance. きやがったな = 'so you showed up, huh'.
